_readme: Fill in every value that still says YOUR, then run `npm run site`. `npm run legal:check` (also run by `npm run release`) lists anything left. The email and country are already set. Publisher name, address and phone appear in the Terms of Use because Apple requires a developer's name, address, phone and email in any custom license agreement, and the EU shows the same details on your App Store page if you sell there as a trader.
developerName: YOUR LEGAL NAME OR COMPANY NAME
address: YOUR MAILING ADDRESS (street or PO box, city, state, ZIP)
phone: YOUR PHONE NUMBER (a Google Voice or business number is fine)
hostingProvider: YOUR STATIC HOST (for example GitHub Pages)
